title: Migrate broadside to fieldwork::db schema
description:
Replace broadside's inline schema (db.rs) with fieldwork::db::migrate(). Major refactor:
- Add fieldwork dependency with db-sqlite feature
- Replace SqlitePool with fieldwork::db::Pool
- Introduce users table: create a single user row per broadside instance
- Map personas to user_id FK
- Replace inline followers table (actor_uri, inbox_uri columns) with remote_accounts FK:
  - On follow receipt: upsert into remote_accounts first, then insert into followers with remote_account_id
  - Update delivery queries to join remote_accounts for inbox_url
- Update timestamp handling: ISO 8601 TEXT -> INTEGER Unix seconds
- Replace schema_meta version tracking with fieldwork::db::migrate() (idempotent CREATE IF NOT EXISTS)
- Update posts table: add user_id, persona_id (TEXT UUID), ap_id, content (plaintext), spoiler_text, visibility columns
- Update delivery_queue: target_inbox, sender_persona_id, activity_json columns
- Remove inline schema constants
- Run full test suite
